title: Data Product Business Analyst
description:
Data Product Business Analyst - London / Birmingham (Flexible hybrid working) | Full-Time / Permanent  

Up to £56k (depending on experience) + bonus and excellent benefits including healthcare, wellbeing support, 27 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, life insurance and more. 

We're looking for a skilled Data Product Business Analyst to join the digital & technology team at Compass Group UK & Ireland - a global leader in food services. 

As part of our Data Product & Delivery team, helping transform business needs into clear, actionable and delivery-ready data product requirements. Working closely with stakeholders, product teams and technical specialists, you'll play a critical role in shaping data-driven solutions that solve real business challenges and deliver measurable value.  

This is an exciting opportunity to influence digital transformation initiatives while supporting Compass Group UK & Ireland's AI First strategy.

Compass Digital & Technology is where ideas turn into possibilities.  

We’re the technology team behind Compass Group UK&I, part of Compass Group, one of the world’s largest hospitality businesses. We’re shaping the next generation of products, platforms and experiences for Compass Group, harnessing AI to create competitive advantage and accelerate growth. 

We create, manage and deploy technology which supports our operators, clients and guests. From enterprise-scale cloud engineering, cybersecurity, mobile ordering and guest-facing experiences to everyday IT support. Our work reaches across our business and all walks of life, from schools to banks and into the daily lives of millions of people.  

But D&T is about more than technology. It’s a place to be curious, challenge what’s possible and turn great ideas into real outcomes. A place where talented people collaborate, experiment, learn and make an impact at scale.  

We own it from idea to outcome. We challenge what’s possible. And together, we’re creating better solutions, every day. 

Data Product Business Analyst - The role

  • Understand and challenge business problems, working with stakeholders to get beyond the initial request and establish the underlying question, desired outcome and value to the business.
  • Gather, analyse and document business and user requirements, ensuring they are clear, complete, testable and ready for delivery.
  • Interrogate and analyse data to validate requirements, test assumptions, identify patterns and anomalies, and build a stronger understanding of the business problem.
  • Map business processes and user journeys to establish operational context, pain points, intended outcomes and data product requirements.
  • Work with stakeholders to define and document KPIs, measures, dimensions, business rules and definitions, identifying conflicting or unresolved definitions and supporting the business in reaching clear agreement.
  • Understand how semantic models, governed measures and business definitions underpin trusted reporting, analytics and future AI capabilities.
  • Identify data availability, quality, completeness and lineage considerations early in discovery and work with Data Engineering, Product Engineering and business stakeholders to understand and address constraints.
  • Create delivery-ready requirements and documentation covering business outcomes, scope, data requirements, business rules, dependencies, assumptions, exclusions and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop clear and testable acceptance criteria, maintaining traceability between the original business problem, requirements, delivered capability and acceptance evidence.
  • Work with Product, Data Engineering, Product Engineering, Data Science, Architecture and Platform teams to assess feasibility and shape the right solution.
  • Challenge one-off and bespoke reporting requests where an existing or reusable data product could meet the need, helping us create scalable capabilities rather than duplicate solutions.
  • Understand how business users consume data and insight through Power BI and other analytical products, ensuring products support effective decision-making rather than simply presenting data.
  • Identify opportunities where advanced analytics, Data Science, predictive techniques, Generative AI, Copilot or AI agents could provide a more effective solution to a business problem and work with specialist teams to shape these opportunities.
  • Define measurable success criteria and intended business benefits, helping Product teams understand whether the delivered capability has created the expected outcome.
  • Support delivery teams throughout the product lifecycle, providing clarification and maintaining requirements and decision traceability as products evolve.
  • Validate delivered solutions against agreed requirements and support user acceptance, business readiness and release readiness activities.
  • Use adoption, user feedback, business insight and product performance to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and product enhancement.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is as comfortable understanding the business and its data as they are defining requirements.

You'll ideally have:

  • Experience gathering, analysing and challenging business and user requirements within a data, digital, technology or product environment.
  • Strong business analysis and process-mapping skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured, testable and delivery-ready requirements.
  • Strong data curiosity, with the confidence to explore data, question numbers, challenge assumptions and investigate what's really driving a business problem.
  • An understanding of analytical and semantic data models, including measures, dimensions, KPIs and business definitions.
  • Experience working with BI and analytical products such as Power BI, with an understanding of how people use data and insight to make operational and commercial decisions.
  • An understanding of data quality, including the ability to identify issues around completeness, consistency, definitions and suitability for use.
  • Experience developing acceptance criteria and supporting solution validation, user acceptance and release readiness.
  • Excellent facilitation, stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the confidence to constructively challenge stakeholders and manage conflicting priorities.
